statement: ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ, (∀ j : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ j f) → Function.support f ⊆ Set.Icc 1 2 → ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ t : ℝ, ‖mellin f ((1/2 : ℂ) + (t : ℂ)*Complex.I)‖ ≤ C/(1+|t|)^A

brief.en: Integrate by parts in logarithmic coordinates. The constant may depend on the test and decay order.
